fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 1.8 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2013.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company primarily uses a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures (purchased call + sold put), call spreads (purchased call + sold call), and fixed price swap agreements. Fuel derivative instruments include swaps and different types of option contracts.
